concentration_time_figure.note: No plasma concentration-time figure is presented in the retrieved body; half-lives are stated in the text.

notes: All three PEPlife2 values are consistent with the body, which states peptide S2's T1/2 = 212.2 ± 58.4 min explicitly and gives 'T1/2 < 16 min' for hirulog-1 and peptide 1, bracketing PEPlife2's 15 ± 1.3 and 13 ± 2.6 min. IDENTICAL SEQUENCE, 16-FOLD DIFFERENT LABEL. PEPlife2 assigns peptide 1 and peptide S2 the SAME sequence string, fPRPGGGGQGDFEPIPEDAYDE, yet records 13 min for one and 212.2 min for the other. The body explains the difference entirely by a modification the string does not encode: S2 'in which the second Gly residue has been replaced with a modified Lys (stearic acid)'. A sequence-to-half-life model sees two contradictory labels for one input, and the 16-fold gap is attributable to a stearoyl group that is invisible in the representation. Note also that the lowercase f in both strings marks D-Phe; the training-set sequence cleaner upper-cases it, so the D-stereochemistry is lost and the residue is read as L-Phe.
